description: Show one product detail in a focused callout video from a single photo. Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds for feeds, listings and product pages.
h1: Product Feature Callout Video for One Clear Detail

steps_h2: How to Make a Product Feature Callout Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: A photo that shows the pump is enough to start. The line names what that press does, and you leave with a clip for the listing.

steps.d: Photograph the serum bottle with the pump in light, or use the listing photo that does. The layout is ready for that part.

faq.q: What is a feature callout template?
faq.a: It is a short demo built so one part gets the attention. For a lipstick, the click is on screen and the line says what one twist does. You skip booking a creator just to point at it.

faq.q: How does the template become the clip?
faq.a: You leave with a demo you can publish. Use the listing photo of a travel mug, rewrite the line so it names the leak-proof lid, and export 9:16 for the shop's TikTok.

faq.q: Why not book a creator to show the feature?
faq.a: A creator's calendar decides when the next demo exists. If the backpack zipper changes, you rewrite the spoken line in this file and post the new cut without waiting on a shoot day.

faq.q: Who should make a one-feature demo this way?
faq.a: Anyone who has to make one part obvious. The owner of a blender brand can do it, and so can the marketer who runs ads for several of those blenders.

faq.q: Can I make a callout without an editing background?
faq.a: Yes. You can walk the three steps and have a demo in a few minutes. A sharp photo of that one part is all the layout needs.

faq.q: Which shops can show one function with this template?
faq.a: Any shop where one part does the selling. A mascara wand, a lunch-box latch, and a kettle lid can share the layout, each with a line about its own motion.

faq.q: May I supply the photos, clips, and logo myself?
faq.a: Yes. The hinge in the demo should be the hinge you ship. A short clip of it closing can join the listing photo, and your logo can sit in the corner the layout leaves open.

faq.q: Where can I post the finished callout?
faq.a: Put the finished demo where shoppers already linger. A 9:16 cut fits TikTok, 1:1 fits the shop grid, 16:9 fits a YouTube pre-roll, and 4:3 or 3:4 covers a Facebook or LinkedIn placement.

faq.q: Is a callout template included with a paid subscription?
faq.a: Yes, it is part of a paid subscription. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits, Pro is $35 with 300, and Premium is $63 with 600. You see each job's credit cost first. A video is 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. A failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Can I use the callout in ads and client projects?
faq.a: Yes. Place it in a paid campaign, on the product page beside the listing photo, or in a file you send a client. The person on camera is an AI avatar.

faq.q: Why use a product feature callout template?
faq.a: Your time goes into the part that matters. A new lipstick keeps the demo's shape, and you only rewrite the line that explains the click.

reviews.h2: How Shops Show One Moving Part
reviews.lead: Each card is how one type of shop shows a single moving part. These are examples, not customer quotes.

items.d: A beauty shop presses the cleanser pump once, so that one action is the whole clip.
A drinkware shop opens a travel-mug lid so the seal is the feature on screen.
A home shop opens a hinged storage lid once so the hinge stays on screen.
A home shop turns a clasp on a ceramic container toward the camera.
An electronics shop holds one port to the camera so a listing can show where the cable goes.
A bag shop runs a zipper once along the track so the hardware is the point of the clip.
An apparel shop shortens a strap once so the strap adjuster is easy to see.
A kitchen shop locks a lid shut in one motion, so the product page can replay that move.
A beauty shop turns a cap off so the closure, not the whole routine, is the subject.
A tool shop presses one button so the control is easy to see, with no second feature on screen.

definition.title: What Is a Feature Callout Template?
paras: A feature callout template is a short selling layout built around one moving part, such as a lid, a hinge, a clasp, or a dial. An AI avatar can demonstrate it, with a script, a voiceover, and captions.
Start from your photo or a public product page. Pick a tall, square, or wide shape and a length, then download a clip for a listing or a paid placement.
